These fixtures are independently hand-encoded from the supplied vanilla 26.3
ComponentSerialization, TranslatableContents and ListTag codecs. They were not
written by Pumpkin, and are not captures from a running Java server. Each `.nbt`
is a complete persistent tripwire-hook item; `.bin` is its unnamed network name
tag. `translation` contains numeric, boolean, string and styled arguments plus
a fallback. Score, NBT, object and future contents exercise opaque preservation.
